audience.text: Python developers needing deterministic, dependency-free MSG/CFB processing without requiring Microsoft Outlook or compiled extensions.

capabilities.text: Read and write Outlook MSG files using MapiMessage, MsgReader, and MsgWriter with full property-stream access.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Convert MSG to EML and vice versa using MapiMessage.to_email_message() and from_email_message() with Python's email.message.EmailMessage.
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Parse and construct Compound File Binary containers using CFBReader, CFBWriter, CFBStorage, and CFBStream.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB processing

capabilities.text: Create messages from scratch, set properties, add recipients and attachments (including embedded messages), and save changes.
capabilities.title: Message composition and editing

capabilities.text: Access and modify MAPI properties and named properties using PropertyId, PropertyTypeCode, and MapiNamedProperty.
capabilities.title: Property and named property access

capabilities.text: Runs as pure Python without compiled extensions, native dependencies, or Microsoft Outlook.
capabilities.title: Pure Python implementation

limitations.text: No IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 mail server connectivity is implemented.
TNEF (winmail.dat) parsing and generation is not supported.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar properties must be accessed generically.
Direct .eml file parsing is not implemented; EML support requires Python's email.parser and EmailMessage.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and writing Outlook MSG files and Compound File Binary containers purely in Python, without external dependencies or native binaries.
Provides two-way conversion between MSG and EML formats using Python's standard email package, avoiding reliance on external mail server protocols.
Supports low-level CFB and MSG parsing and construction for advanced users needing direct property-stream access.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for reading, writing, and converting Outlook MSG and CFB files, with two-way conversion to/from Python's standard EmailMessage for EML handling.

uncertainties: The exact scope of 'no mail server support'—whether it includes any local mail storage formats beyond MSG/CFB/EML—is not clarified beyond the README.
Whether MapiMessage.from_file() supports streaming or only file paths is not evident from examples.
The behavior of strict mode in MapiMessage.from_file() and MsgReader.from_file() is not described beyond presence of the parameter.
How validation_issues are populated and exposed across APIs is not detailed beyond symbol existence.
The handling of Unicode strings and the unicode_strings flag in MapiMessage is not explained in examples.
Whether embedded message attachments preserve all original properties is not demonstrated.
The versioning scheme for releases (vYY.M) and its mapping to package version 26.3 is not explained.
The relationship between the FOSS library and Aspose.Email for Python — Enterprise Edition beyond feature comparisons is not detailed.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Load an MSG file using MapiMessage.from_file() and access its subject property.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a new MapiMessage, set sender, recipients, and attachments, then save it as MSG and convert to EML.

workflows.name: Convert MSG to EML
workflows.text: Load MSG, convert to EmailMessage via to_email_message(), and write as EML using as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse EML with Python's BytesParser, then construct MapiMessage via from_email_message() and save as MSG.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Build or read a CFB container using CFBReader/CFBWriter and traverse storages and streams.
